newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. firm to sell car insurance by mail in Japan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. firm to sell car insurance by mail in Japan.

text.p: American Home Assurance Co said on Friday that it would begin selling automobile insurance policies through the mail in Japan in December.
The U.S. insurer is the first company to launch such a service in Japan.
The company obtained government approval on October 11, after the Japanese government removed its ban on mail-order sales of auto insurance earlier that month.
The U.S. insurer's move comes at a time when the Japanese and U.S. governments are locked in a dispute over the deregulation of Japan's insurance market.
Mail-order sales of insurance policies are expected to help foreign insurance companies which have been seeking to expand their business in Japan but lack an extensive network of sales agents.
American Home Assurance was the first company to launch mail-order sales of damage insurance policies in Japan when it did so in 1982.
